def solve():
    grid_str = """

+ + + + + + + + + + + + - + $ + + + +
+ + + + $ + - - + - * + - - + + + + +

+ $ + + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + + + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + X @ - + - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ - - - - - - - - + - - - - - - - - +
+ X - - @ - - - - - - X - @ - - @ X +
+ - - + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - +
+ + - - - - - - - - - - - - - - + + +
+ + - - - - - + + - @ - - + + + + + +
+ + + + - - - + + - - X + + + + + + +
+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
"""
    grid = [line.split() for line in grid_str.strip().split('\n')]
    walls = set(); goals = set(); boxes = set(); player_pos = None
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            char = grid[r][c]
            if char == '+': walls.add((r, c))
            elif char == 'X': goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '@': boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == '*': player_pos = (r, c)
            elif char == '$': boxes.add((r, c)); goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '%': player_pos = (r, c); goals.add((r, c))

    def get_heuristic(boxes):
        total_dist = 0
        for b in boxes:
            total_dist += min(abs(b[0]-g[0]) + abs(b[1]-g[1]) for g in goals)
        return total_dist

    def is_deadlock(b, boxes):
        if b in goals: return False
        r, c = b
        # Simple corner deadlock
        if (((r-1, c) in walls and (r, c-1) in walls) or
            ((r-1, c) in walls and (r, c+1) in walls) or
            ((r+1, c) in walls and (r, c-1) in walls) or
            ((r+1, c) in walls and (r, c+1) in walls)):
            return True
        return False

    start_boxes = tuple(sorted(boxes))
    # heap elements: (f_score, path_len, player_pos, boxes, path)
    pq = [(get_heuristic(start_boxes), 0, player_pos, start_boxes, "")]
    visited = {(player_pos, start_boxes): 0}

    while pq:
        f, g, (r, c), b_pos, path = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if set(b_pos) == goals: return path
        if g > visited.get(((r, c), b_pos), float('inf')): continue

        for dr, dc, m in [(-1, 0, 'U'), (1, 0, 'D'), (0, -1, 'L'), (0, 1, 'R')]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if (nr, nc) in walls: continue
            if (nr, nc) in b_pos:
                nnr, nnc = nr + dr, nc + dc
                if (nnr, nnc) in walls or (nnr, nnc) in b_pos: continue
                if is_deadlock((nnr, nnc), b_pos): continue
                new_boxes = tuple(sorted([p if p != (nr, nc) else (nnr, nnc) for p in b_pos]))
                if ((nr, nc), new_boxes) not in visited or g + 1 < visited[((nr, nc), new_boxes)]:
                    visited[((nr, nc), new_boxes)] = g + 1
                    h = get_heuristic(new_boxes)
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (g + 1 + h, g + 1, (nr, nc), new_boxes, path + m))
            else:
                if ((nr, nc), b_pos) not in visited or g + 1 < visited[((nr, nc), b_pos)]:
                    visited[((nr, nc), b_pos)] = g + 1
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (g + 1 + get_heuristic(b_pos), g + 1, (nr, nc), b_pos, path + m))
    return None

print(solve())"}
